text:
deploy-bot: Release deployed: rel/2026.03.15-smallpatch (commit abc1234) to canary 20% traffic. All checks passed. :rocket:

alex: seeing a spike in 5xxs on embeddings-prod canary for ~3m, 95p latency up to ~1.8s, error rate bumped from ~5% to ~12%. Adding @marta oncall.

incident-bot: INCIDENT opened: high error rate on embeddings-prod (canary) — paging oncall @marta — https://internal.incident/4109876500

marta: oncall marta here, pulling traces and tails. @samir did this patch touch the tokenizer pooling path?

samir: yep, commit abc1234 introduces tokenizer_pool_v2 and switches the batch pooling logic. Rolled to canary 20%. I saw a couple of odd GC logs during staging but nothing flagged.

emily: tailing logs now — getting repeated stacktraces from tokenizer: "TokenBufferOverflowError" for inputs > ~1000 tokens. Repro on a long prompt locally with a stress script. Not failing on shorter prompts.

marta: immediate mitigation — flip the feature flag for canary to the old pool. If we can toggle per-canary, do that first. @deploy-bot can you flip `tokenizer_pool_v2` -> `false` for env=canary?

deploy-bot: Flag toggle requested: `tokenizer_pool_v2=false` for scope=canary. Action succeeded. :white_check_mark:

emily: metrics: error rate dropped from 12% -> 2% within 2 minutes after the flag flip. 95p latency down to ~420ms. Rolling baseline restored.

alex: nice. If the flag toggle isn't adequate for full production rollout we'll need a single-commit revert + fastpatch.

marta: agree. I'll coordinate a revert PR and fastpatch. Plan: 1) kill flag on canary (done), 2) open revert PR (git revert abc1234), 3) run canary fastpatch and smoke, 4) roll to prod. @samir can you open the revert and add a short regression test for long inputs?

samir: opening revert PR now and adding a test to cap tokenizer pooling path for inputs > 1024 until we rework pooling. Commands I'm running:

```
# create revert
git checkout -b revert/abc1234-fastpatch
git revert abc1234 --no-commit
# add regression test
git add tests/test_tokenizer_long_inputs.py
git commit -m "revert(tokenizer): revert abc1234 + add long-input regression"
git push origin revert/abc1234-fastpatch
```

deploy-bot: PR opened: #789 revert abc1234 — CI running.

jen-cs: CS update — affected customers appear to be orgs with sustained long-context usage. I see ~12 orgs crossing >5% error window; two enterprise customers (Acme, Omnicorp) reported degraded completions to CS during the incident window. Drafting a proactive note to stakeholders. ETA 30m.

marta: ok. Once CI is green we'll canary the revert and run a 10m smoke. @emily can you run smoke and confirm? If smoke is clean, we push to prod.

emily: will run smoke for 10m on canary after PR merge. Also adding a quick monitoring query to watch 5xx and 95p latency: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embeddings",env="prod"}[1m])) by (code)` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="embeddings"}[5m]))`.

deploy-bot: CI for #789 passed. Triggering canary deploy for rel/2026.03.15-fix1 (revert).

emily: canary smoke (10m) started. No elevated 5xxs so far, 95p latency stable.

emily: smoke passed 10m, no regressions observed.

marta: proceed with prod rollout of fastpatch. Deploying in 3m — will monitor for 15m at minimum.

deploy-bot: Fastpatch deploy initiated: rel/2026.03.15-fix1 -> canary -> staged -> prod. Logs: https://internal.deploy/rel/2026.03.15-fix1

alex: monitoring dashboards — 5xxs back to baseline (<1%), 95p latency normal. Good to close mitigation.

jen-cs: customer note sent to affected contacts summarizing: root cause, mitigation (flag kill + single-commit revert), action items, and timeline. Will provide a draft postmortem blurb to PMs.

marta: handing off to postmortem owners @samir and @emily. Please include timeline, RCA, regression test, and a follow-up to add per-canary flag toggle capability if needed. I'll leave the incident channel open for 1h; will close if no further regressions.

incident-bot: Incident resolved by mitigation: feature-flag kill + single-commit revert. Incident ticket: INC-20260315-01. Severity: Sev3.

alex: nice coordination — thanks all. :tada:

samir: adding action item list: 1) revert merged (complete), 2) regression test added (in PR), 3) implement input-length guard in tokenizer (backlog item), 4) add per-canary flag scope docs and automated toggle playbook.

marta: logging this thread into the postmortem doc and closing here unless something else pops up.

jen-cs: will follow up with affected customers after postmortem is published.

deploy-bot: Closing notes: release rel/2026.03.15-smallpatch reverted in fix rel/2026.03.15-fix1. Canary->prod verified. :white_check_mark:
